items.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: the music of George Jones and Tammy Wynette and Loretta Lynn, stuff like that.

ctx.x: That’s a great name, by the way. I love that name.

It was a great name. It was a lot of fun. But it was one of those bands that, you know, it’s hard to get thirteen people together in the same place at the same time to rehearse or do gigs. So it was popular but short-lived. And then from that I was in a band called Beckaroo, which was a smaller band so it had maybe a better chance of rehearsing and stuff, but even that petered out eventually. And that was a little later. That was kind of 60s country, so it was some electric instruments and pedal steel and…
Was that like a bar band?
